source_title: International Capital Flow Pressures and Global Factors
methodology: Exchange Market Pressure index; panel regression across countries
extraction_note: claim_text 是从英文原文读出的中文转述；evidence_span 是论文原句，可逐字核对。方向判定由人工做出，不是规则抽取。

claims.claim_text: 风险情绪恶化（VIX 上升）平均导致国际资本流出压力与贬值压力——这是跨国面板上的平均效应。
claims.evidence_span: deteriorated risk sentiment as reflected by positive changes

claims.claim_text: 资本流压力对风险情绪的敏感度随时间演变、跨国差异显著，且在常态与极端压力期之间不同；避险货币地位与自证式汇率预期和套息交易融资货币相关，而与传统宏观特征的关联很弱。
claims.evidence_span: evolves over time, varies significantly across countries, and differs between normal time and extreme stress events
